one_line: Tang dynasty envoy and commander who led a retaliatory expedition after being attacked near Kannauj around 647–649 CE.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean and athletic with a wiry, disciplined build.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, fair-to-light tan North Chinese complexion, sharp straight nose, narrow dark-brown eyes with focused anime intensity, neat trimmed moustache with a small pointed goatee, default expression calm and observant with a hint of tactical alertness.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair gathered into a high Tang-style topknot secured by a dark lacquered wooden hairpin, the rest of the hair bound and tucked under a small rounded dark-green Tang official cap with a short, stiff ridge and no long side flaps.
appearance.costume: Early Tang envoy-general attire: an inner pale-cream silk robe with narrow sleeves, over it a knee-length deep-red wraparound outer robe (ru) with slightly wider sleeves, bound with a broad dark-brown leather belt fitted with simple bronze studs and a small ornate buckle; over the robes, a sleeveless lamellar cuirass of overlapping dark-brown lacquered leather plates laced with black cords, reaching just above the knee and vented at the sides, with a short dark-grey padded shoulder guard panel on each shoulder; trousers are straight, sturdy dark-blue cloth tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with slightly upturned toes; a narrow dark-green silk sash hangs from the belt on the left side, and a simple rectangular bamboo dispatch case and small bronze tally token hang on the right; no extravagant patterns, only subtle woven borders in darker red along the robe edges.
appearance.signature: A straight single-edged Tang dao sword with a slightly curved steel blade, plain brass guard, dark-brown wrapped hilt, and a dark-red lacquered wooden scabbard hanging from his belt on the left hip.

ref_desc: Wang Xuance is a mid-30s lean Tang envoy-general with an oval light-tan face, narrow intense eyes, black hair in a high topknot under a small dark-green cap, wearing deep-red and cream robes under dark-brown lamellar armour with dark-blue trousers and brown boots, carrying a dark-red scabbarded Tang dao at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Wang Xuance, a mid-30s lean Tang dynasty envoy-general with an oval light-tan face, high cheekbones, narrow dark-brown eyes, and a neat trimmed moustache with a small pointed goatee, his straight black hair gathered into a high topknot secured with a dark wooden hairpin and covered by a small rounded dark-green Tang official cap; dress him in an early Tang outfit of a pale-cream inner silk robe and a knee-length deep-red outer wrap robe with subtle darker red borders, cinched by a broad dark-brown leather belt with simple bronze studs, over which he wears a sleeveless dark-brown lacquered leather lamellar cuirass laced with black cords and short dark-grey padded shoulder panels, paired with sturdy dark-blue trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots, a narrow dark-green silk sash hanging from his belt and a small bamboo dispatch case and bronze tally token on the other side; at his left hip hang a straight single-edged Tang dao in a dark-red lacquered wooden scabbard with a brass guard and dark-brown wrapped hilt; show him from multiple full-body angles with consistent deep-red, dark-green, dark-brown, pale-cream and dark-blue colours, emphasizing a calm, tactically alert expression and dignified, historically grounded military-diplomatic presence.
